messages.text: Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Searched the catalog · Nexus S1 10TH/s miner

The N. S1 isn't a Harlo unit, so Harlo OS isn't its firmware. The S1 runs its own firmware with a built-in LCD and the HeliumDeploy app, and it ships with the Mean Well PSU and stand, $699, 10 TH/s at ~150W.

Harlo OS runs on our Harlo and Hammer miners, like the Harlo B30 (30 TH/s, $899). Downloads, release notes and guides live at harlolabs.com.

What are you after, the Harlo dashboard specifically, or just a quiet home miner? I'll point you at the right one.

I received an email from heliumdelploy saying i could upgrade the os on the miners i have ordered and it listed the 3 s1's and the 3 nerdqaxe++ and the NerdOctaxe and the Magic Miner 40T I should get in about a month.

I don't want to guess which units that email covers, so I'll get JD, our technical lead, to confirm exactly what the upgrade applies to on your S1s, NerdQaxe++, NerdOctaxe and the 40T.

Fastest route if you want an answer right now: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD. He's very active there. Otherwise he'll reply here or by email.

Harlo OS downloads and release notes live at harlolabs.com if you want to look ahead.
